parameters.content:
## Build verified league or club recaps with a final-score fact sheet

### How it works
Read recent events from TheSportsDB. Keep verified final matches in the requested league and completed date window, reject conflicting scores, and optionally focus on one club. Rank scorelines, calculate returned-match totals and club form, and create a deterministic recap with a fact sheet. A separate recovery log skips completed keys and resumes accepted jobs. Review the video and CSV before sharing.

### Setup
1. Install **`@zvid/n8n-nodes-zvid`** from **Settings → Community nodes** before credentials. A workspace owner/admin may need to install it.
2. Create a **Zvid API** credential with [your key](https://app.zvid.io/api-keys) and Base URL `https://api.zvid.io`; select it on all Zvid nodes.
3. Connect Google Sheets and select the **Sports Recaps** log tab. Create RenderKey, Status, JobId, CreditsQuoted, PlanJson, VideoUrl and CompletedAt headers; optional delivery also needs DeliveryStatus.
4. Configure sportsDbKey, leagueId, optional focusTeam and completed periodStart/periodEnd. See the [source contract and migration guide](https://github.com/Zvid-io/zvid-n8n/blob/master/workflows/sports-recap-video.md).
5. **dryRun=false spends credits.** true returns JSON and a quote only. Set maxCreditsPerVideo, then test manually before enabling the schedule.
6. Avoid overlapping executions. Inspect submitting, failed or uncertain jobs before resetting any log row.

### Customization
Adjust branding and the domain rules in **Set the league club and completed recap period**. Watch downloads time out after 30 seconds; the saved URL remains available.

nodes.name: 1. Choose source rules and schedule

parameters.content:
## 1. Choose source rules and schedule

Complete the overview setup and source contract. Run one execution at a time. Use the manual trigger before enabling the schedule.

nodes.name: 2. Check the real source and plan the output

parameters.content:
## 2. Check the real source and plan the output

Filter league, club, dates and verified final statuses. Optional latest-available mode can use older returned finals within maxFallbackAgeDays; the video shows their actual period. Explicit date ranges stay strict.

nodes.name: 3. Recover accepted work before a new render

parameters.content:
## 3. Recover accepted work before a new render

Saved jobs follow the upper route using their original review context. New work continues through optional media and the domain design.

nodes.name: 4. Check optional background music

parameters.content:
## 4. Check optional background music

A failed or oversized music file is skipped. Empty musicUrl continues without an external request. This check preserves the selected source plan.

nodes.name: 5. Build and validate the design and credit ceiling

parameters.content:
## 5. Build and validate the design and credit ceiling

dryRun=true returns the source plan, design JSON and quote. It performs no log writes, editor draft creation, render, or delivery.

nodes.name: 6. Reserve the key and preserve the accepted job

parameters.content:
## 6. Reserve the key and preserve the accepted job

Save the key and accepted job ID. Retry explicit capacity rejections up to three attempts, respecting the server delay and a 30-second minimum. Uncertain submissions require inspection. Sheets is not an atomic lock.

nodes.name: 7. Wait for the accepted render and record its result

parameters.content:
## 7. Wait for the accepted render and record its result

Poll the saved job within the deadline. Keep failed, timed-out and uncertain job IDs for inspection. Completed keys are skipped on later runs.

nodes.name: 8. Review the video and source-specific handoff

parameters.content:
## 8. Review the video and source-specific handoff

Completed renders reach Watch video → Binary → data → View. A failed render stops with its actual reason after saving the tracking row. Download the review CSV and check source facts before sharing.
